D/ IMP ANTONINVS PIVS AVG ; R/ VICTORIA AVG ; D/ IMP C MAVR SEV ALEXAND AVG ; R/ PM TR P COS PP ; D/ IMP ALEXANDER PIVS AVG ; R/ IOVI PROPVGNATORI ; D/ IMP MAXIMINVS PIVS AVG ; R/ FIDES MILITVM ; D/ IMP GORDIANVS PIVS FEL AVG ; R/ LAETITIA AVG N ; D/ IMP CAE C VIB TREB GALLVS AVG ; D/ GALLIENVS PF A

TREASURE CASE 2012 T888. A small hoard of four base silver denari and five base silver radiates dating to the 3rd century AD. 1. A base silver denarius of Elagabalus dating to the period AD 210 - 222 (Reece Period 10). VICTORIA AVG reverse type depicting Victory flying left holding wreath. Mint of Rome. Obverse Inscription: IMP ANTONINVS PIVS AVG. Obverse Description: Laureate and draped bust…
